_comment: Everything the evaluator must reproduce from how demo_data_processed was built.
Verified: applying gripper_range to the raw qpos columns reproduces the converted
--gripper_norm dataset, and from the ManiSkill env defaults used at generation.

task_instructions.PushCube-v1: Push the cube across the surface to the target location.
task_instructions.PlaceSphere-v1: Pick up the sphere and place it precisely into the target.
task_instructions.PullCube-v1: Pull the cube toward the target marker.
task_instructions.LiftPegUpright-v1: Lift the peg and stand it upright.
task_instructions.StackCube-v1: Stack the cube on top of the other cube.
